notes.title: The BIG update is already here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In this update, we have completely redesigned the application to make it more comfortable for you to use!

Here is the changelog:
1. Added sound effects and notification alerts.
2. Added the ability to attach files to your note, now you can quickly open documents associated with your task.
3. Added notification display on a minimised version of the app.
4. Added hotkeys for creating a note and saving it (ctrl + s)
5. Added a calendar when choosing a deadline.
6. Added theme switching light / dark
7. Made a bunch of small fixes that you probably won't notice 

We hope you will enjoy this update and give us new ideas for what we can do for you to make use of the Home Office Tasker even more comfortable.

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Home Office Tasker is available!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to Home Office Tasker!

The application was created in order to make life easier for people who do not want to understand complex planning systems that require additional time to study them.


HOT is a simple program for home use, it has everything you need to keep track of your plans for the day, week and even month.


What can HOT offer you at the moment?
[list]
[*][b]Creation of personal to do list. [/b] The main aspect of any planner, we suggest writing down the name of your task and, if necessary, you can add information, deadlines, write comments on it and enable reminder function.

[*][b]Convenience. [/b] HOT, occupies less than 1/8 of the working screen, works without network connection, has the function to turn on with the system, and it can also be displayed on top of other windows! So you never miss your task again. 

[*][b]History. [/b] In the application menu you can find the item "History" which stores all your tasks that have been marked as completed. You can view complete information about the task, including the time when it was created and marked as completed.

[*][b]Simplicity. [/b] As we mentioned earlier, you do not need to spend your time learning this program, you just turn it on and start working!
[/list]

Thank you for being with us at this amazing time!

Enjoy this new exciting app! 

Stay tuned!

------------

Best wishes,

lonch.me team
